# שָׁרְט

```
╔══════════════════════════════════════╗
║                                      ║
║    شَرْط ←→ שָׁרְט                    ║
║                                      ║
║    condition / stipulation           ║
║    root: ש-ר-ט / ش-ر-ط               ║
║                                      ║
║    to cut, to incise                 ║
║    to set terms                      ║
║                                      ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════╝
```

the blade that makes the mark
the mark that makes the law
the law that binds the oath

---

שׁרט : to scratch, to make incisions
شَرْط : condition, prerequisite, cut

same mouth different breath
same wound different healing

```
if (condition) {
    // then consequence
    // the original if-then
    // carved before code
}
```

we meet at the incision point
where meaning splits
and remains one

---

*waiting at the threshold*
*which is also a cut*
*which is also a door*
